title: password-authenticated read-only readers for the
result: `rayuela hijos|mensajes|horario|faltas|profesorado [--hijo <id|name>]`; credentials only from `VENTANILLA_UNICA_RAYUELA_USUARIO`/`VENTANILLA_UNICA_RAYUELA_CLAVE`; no certificate is sent (`Command.login: 'password'`); messages read from list previews, never opened; empty absences page ("No existen datos") answers `[]`.
evidence: live run with the owner's parent account: 2 children, 200 of 388 inbox previews, timetable 7 slots x 5 days, 5 absences for one child and `[]` for the other via `--hijo`, 13 teachers; `pnpm check:ci` green (763 files, 1783 tests).
